notes.title: The Depths of Tor has been released!
notes.content:
[h1]The Depths of Tor dungeon is now live![/h1]

[h3]Hello everyone, we have a big content update today![/h3]

[h3]Explore the caves of Tor buried deep in the southern mountains. A forgotten place that hides many terrifying creatures and powerful artifacts. Go into its darkest depths and wrest its secrets for your arsenal, and then defeat the foul guardians within![/h3]

[list]
[*][b]14 new class abilities![/b]
[*][b]16 new types of enemies to discover and fight![/b]
[*][b]2 new bosses to test your mettle![/b]
[*][b]18 new weapons to find and wield![/b]
[*][b]22 new types of armor to guard against your foes![/b]
[*][b]4 new mystical accessories to craft for more advantages![/b]
[/list]

notes.title: Content patch 1!
notes.content:
[h1]First content patch is live![/h1]
Hello all!

Just dropping in with a content update for everyone! I made some changes and added some content!

[list]
[*] World Interaction - You can interact with all sorts of environmental objects now. You will find some side quests and items in those nooks and crannies!
[*] Malefic Thicket - The third dungeon is now fully revamped, with additional maps, sidequests, items, and a mysterious teleportation device for you to find...
[/list]

[h1]Next up:[/h1]
[list]
[*] A fourth dungeon set in a mountain mine. The miners may have dug a little too deep... and found something long buried and forgotten.
[*] More abilities for all of the avatars!
[*] More gear for all of the avatars!
[*] New locations on the map to visit!
[/list]

Have fun with this content update, everyone!
